title: Tunisian Chickpea Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Tunisia, made with chickpeas, warmly spiced, and featuring a rich and slightly sweet tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the warmly spiced Tunisian olive oil in a large clay or ceramic pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and tagine. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the flavors have melded together and the chickpeas are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
